status.detail: The guarded short-path projection attempt reached its wrapper's MSBuild invocation and reported Build failed, but captured neither a numeric exit code nor detailed MSBuild diagnostics. No target-guard execution, CsWinRT child result or generated file is evidenced, so this is not a projection result or an upstream defect. Source inspection found a malformed target switch and stderr handling that could interrupt exit capture; a corrected private response and direct durable-log runner are prepared but unrun. The exact originating command session completed with exit code one. Missing process-identity records mean historical descendant-exit-before-lock-release ordering remains unproven and is not retroactively claimed. Dependency asset and import hashes remained unchanged.
